design: Authorized post-hoc bounded engineering diagnostic, frozen before new integrations
condition: Only retained actual GPU 100 pA added pulse, 80 substeps per ms; no GPU rerun
inputs: Four checksum-pinned original native files; original float32 initial state, parameters and holding/pulse current promoted without fitting
variants: Independent smooth DOP853 rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-10, max_step 0.5 ms
Independent smooth DOP853 rtol 1e-11, atol 1e-12, max_step 0.1 ms
Independent coupled float64 classical RK4, nominal dt 1/80 ms and exact reciprocal/one-sixth
Float64 RK4 with jointly promoted float32 dt, reciprocal and one-sixth coefficients
Explicit scalar float32 RK4 operation rounding without FMA; no compiled GPU equivalence claim
stimulus: Exact transition at 100 ms, retained holding baseline before it; full per-substep states
stop: No resets implemented. Save fixed smooth prefix; comparisons stop at the earliest lower endpoint of any first-crossing bracket. Beyond-crossing smooth extensions are not reset-model trajectories.
comparisons: Native versus each variant; DOP853 refinement; each float64 RK4 versus tight DOP853; joint coefficient sensitivity; explicit float32 versus matched float64. Report max absolute, RMS, signed endpoint and first absolute exceedance of 1e-5 mV or pA, plus all predefined checkpoints.
reference_reliability: If either component's maximum DOP853 refinement difference exceeds 1e-7 mV or pA on the common prefix, do not attribute production drift using this reference. This state reliability check is engineering-only and does not amend original event gates.
interpretation: Locate or bound drift in this one pre-first-reset condition. Distinguish coefficient sensitivity, scalar operation rounding, and residual compiled arithmetic differences where possible; no exact FMA attribution without compiler-level evidence. First-exceedance threshold is descriptive telemetry, not acceptance or biological tolerance.
preservation: Original failed numerical gates, target, results, model, backend and existing archives remain unchanged. No retuning, new biological validation, broader conditions or parameter/current optimization. Separately authorized post-hoc biological comparison remains explicitly exploratory.
completion: Stop after this condition and report what the evidence can and cannot locate. Preserve failures; update the existing draft PR and exact-head checks without merging.
